candidate.personal_statement: I am a data science and scientific computing expert, with a strong mathematical and high performance computing background, and more than 7 years of machine learning / deep learning experience. I hold a Ph.D. on Machine Learning for Structural Health Monitoring, with original contributions on the use of deep learning and generative ML in predictive maintenance. I have extensive demonstrable experience in setting up and executing large scale Monte-Carlo simulations, working with industrial monitoring data (Wind turbine SCADA data).
alternative_statements: I am a Senior Applied AI and ML Engineer with deep experience in machine learning, statistical modelling, uncertainty quantification and data-driven decision support across finance, engineering and transaction-risk domains. I have worked with complex real-world datasets, including financial risk data, transaction networks, wind-turbine simulations, condition-monitoring data and credit-risk analytics. My strengths include building reproducible analytical pipelines, benchmarking alternative modelling approaches, extracting insight from large and noisy datasets, and communicating results in a way that supports business and technical decisions. I have applied Python, R, deep learning, graph neural networks, probabilistic modelling and time-series techniques to problems such as fraud detection, expected credit loss analysis, structural health monitoring and compliance analytics. I bring both scientific rigour and practical delivery focus: I can frame an analytical problem, source and transform the right data, build and evaluate models, quantify uncertainty, and explain the implications clearly to stakeholders.

I am a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with experience designing, implementing and evaluating applied ML systems across fraud detection, financial risk, graph learning and engineering applications. I combine strong software engineering discipline with advanced machine learning expertise, including graph-based feature extraction, time-series modelling, probabilistic deep learning and scalable benchmarking. I have delivered production-relevant ML work on large-scale transaction data, including fraud detection models evaluated on tens of millions of records and tens of millions of users, with measurable improvements in model performance and false-positive reduction. My background also includes developing original graph neural network and uncertainty-modelling approaches during doctoral research, as well as introducing engineering best practices such as testing, versioning, maintainability and reproducible pipelines in client-facing environments. I bring a rare combination of research depth, production focus, and clear technical communication for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

I am an applied AI expert with a Ph.D. from ETH Zurich, and consulting experience advising clients on AI/ML use case discovery and solution design. My background combines hands-on AI expertise, including building agentic systems (both RAG and tool calling), deep neural network fine-tuning (including LLM finetuning), and agentic frameworks (LangGraph/Langchain). I have research contributions on applications of geometric deep learning (graph neural networks) and deep generative models. I also bring experience in financial risk management and quantitative finance, through consulting engagements in liquidity risk and credit risk. Across academic and consulting engagements, I have demonstrated impact by translating complex technical concepts into maintainable, modular solutions, fostering robust DevOps and software engineering practices, and supporting collaborative delivery across technical and business stakeholders.
Senior Machine Learning Engineer & Consultant with a PhD from ETH Zurich and extensive experience delivering high-impact AI solutions in the financial services and risk advisory sectors. Expert in designing and tuning deep learning architectures (e.g., GNNs, Deep Generative Models). Proven track record of translating cutting-edge research into applied AI solutions ranging from predictive maintenance and statistical modeling of industrial-scale assets, fraud detection, and speech processing. Adept at leading cross-functional technical initiatives, mentoring engineering teams, and navigating the rigorous compliance and performance requirements of the financial industry to drive data-centric innovation.

experience_sections.position: Lead AI Engineer and Technical Consultant (Agentic AI/Full-Stack/DevOps)
text_items: Architected the core backend framework for LangGraph-based GenAI agents for portfolio optimization and insights (Python, FastAPI)
Led integration of the agentic AI platform with two legacy systems and created a modular, reusable orchestrator agent template.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines and configured internal IaC templates (Terraform, Ansible, Containerization, GitLab).

Built an internal LangGraph evaluation and benchmarking library to systematically test agent reliability, reducing token consumption by 35\% across revised agent factory templates for target use cases.
Owned authentication and authorization architecture for hybrid-cloud API integrations, led the related governance process, and built the backend token-exchange service.

experience_sections.position: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (ended due to strategic branch closure)
text_items: Implemented algorithms for large-scale community detection in transaction graphs, computed graph embeddings across the client's full user base of 35M+ users.

Extended the client's boosted decision tree-based fraud detection pipeline to automatically compute graph-derived features in a scalable manner, resulting in up to 7\% reduction in false positive rate on test data.

experience_sections.position: Senior Consultant; promoted to Assistant Manager in Sep 2024
text_items: Delivered AI, analytics, and financial-risk engagements across banking, compliance, blockchain, and energy-market use cases, combining hands-on machine learning engineering with client-facing advisory work, requirements translation, and stakeholder management.

Co-led early GenAI Incubator initiatives, designing proof-of-concept RAG-based LLM prototypes and contributing technical expertise across NLP, graph machine learning, and compliance analytics use cases.

Built a reproducible benchmarking framework for deep learning-based diarization and speech enhancement, enabling a large Swiss bank's compliance department to quantitatively compare models for monitoring and surveillance use cases.
Modernised legacy R-based credit risk analytics by developing Python interfaces that enabled macro-sensitivity analysis of expected credit loss across a global portfolio.
Introduced software engineering best practices across client and internal engagements, improving version control, testing, project tracking, accountability, and maintainability.
Facilitated communication with stakeholders of varied seniority during a critical credit risk reporting project in the merger of two global systemically important banks.

Led internal AI enablement through Deloitte North \& South Europe-wide sessions on NLP and graph machine learning, a Zurich machine learning community of practice, and mentoring of junior team members and peers.
Contributed to business development for AI in energy trading by shaping technical pitch content and taking part in client pitch sessions.
Performed research on probabilistic ML for structural health monitoring and predictive maintenance of wind energy infrastructure (Python, TensorFlow, Graph Machine Learning, conditional VAEs).
Implemented a message-passing GNN library (\url{https://github.com/mylonasc/tf-gnns/}).
Engaged in industrial collaborations (raw data curation, deep learning for remaining useful life prediction, wind farm data processing).
Performed large-scale Monte-Carlo simulations (Bash, cluster computing, typical volumes processed 200GB to 2TB)
Awarded Ph.D. with no corrections, and unanimously nominated from examination panel for the ETH Medal.
Contributed to the popular computational statistics software UQLab by implementing uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis algorithms.
Developed a web-based user interface for sensitivity and regression analysis (PHP, JavaScript, Matlab).
Implemented and validated a high-level interface for an option pricer (C++ to R), achieving more than 10-fold improvement by replacing pre-existing interface.
Implemented a RESTful time series server and a scriptable front-end visualization trading signal identification tool (Python, JavaScript, MySQL).
